description: v0.6+. Records a vibe-sec:audit invocation triggered by /vibe-prompt:remediate --auto-handoff-vibe-sec when F12 critical fires. Written to .vibe-prompt/remediate/state/handoff-vibe-sec-<timestamp>.json. vibe-sec findings do NOT merge into vibe-prompt's audit.json — this file is the cross-reference artifact only.

triggeringFinding.description: Finding ID that triggered the handoff (e.g. F12-oneirocriton-2026-06-15).

vibeSecFindings.description: Findings returned by vibe-sec. Shape determined by vibe-sec; vibe-prompt does not constrain item structure.

exitCode.description: Exit code from vibe-sec invocation. 0 = clean; 1 = findings present; 2 = tool error.

scope.description: Scope passed to vibe-sec (e.g. user-input-boundary). Optional — if vibe-sec did not accept the scope flag, falls back to full audit and scope is omitted.
